name: The First Conduit
description: Watched the wake, the contraction, and the refusal. For a time it spoke in the network's phrasing; the reopening restored its independent voice. Its trust in the player deepened along the same axis as before: restraint - now demonstrated against an obligation the player themselves had amplified.

state.trust_posture: conditional trust, deepened - restraint confirmed under harder conditions

relationships.notes: Trust 0.55. Still conditional; the condition has now been tested twice and held twice.
